name: Compound Clustering
description: Groups a list of compounds (e.g. the keep-list that survived structure-alerts triage) into distinct chemical families. Three methods are selectable at runtime: Taylor-Butina clustering on Morgan/ECFP fingerprints + Tanimoto distance (auto-discovers the number of families), Bemis-Murcko scaffold grouping (each family shares one ring-system core), or scikit-learn k-means at a fixed cluster count. Returns a per-compound cluster assignment plus a per-cluster summary with a representative for each family. Built on RDKit and scikit-learn.

compounds.description: List of {smiles, id} compound objects; both fields required

id.description: Unique identifier passed through from input

cluster.description: 1-based cluster (chemical family) id this compound was assigned to

is_representative.description: True if this compound is the representative (centroid / core member) of its cluster

representative_id.description: id of the cluster's representative compound

errors.description: Compounds whose SMILES could not be parsed, as {id, smiles}

num_singletons.description: Clusters with exactly one member (lone chemotypes)

images.description: Present only when a render was requested. Maps 'grid' / 'chemical_space' to the written PNG filename in the output folder, or '<name>_error' to the reason a render was skipped.

grid.description: Filename of the per-cluster structure grid (clusters.png)

chemical_space.description: Filename of the PCA chemical-space scatter (chemical_space.png)

method.description: Clustering method. butina: similarity-threshold clustering (auto cluster count). scaffold: group by shared Bemis-Murcko scaffold. kmeans: fixed-count clustering on fingerprints.

fingerprint.description: Fingerprint for similarity (butina / kmeans). ecfp4/ecfp6 are Morgan at radius 2/3; maccs is the fixed 167-bit key set.

cutoff.description: Butina Tanimoto DISTANCE threshold; compounds within this distance cluster together (0.35 distance ≈ 0.65 similarity).

n_clusters.description: Number of clusters for the kmeans method (capped at the number of compounds).

generic_scaffold.description: Scaffold method only: reduce to the generic ring skeleton (atom/bond types erased) before grouping.

render_grid.description: Also render a 2D structure grid grouped by cluster (representative starred) to clusters.png in the output folder.

render_chemical_space.description: Also render a PCA scatter of Morgan fingerprints colored by cluster to chemical_space.png in the output folder (needs at least 3 valid molecules).
